Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
I’ve grouped the dates by the statutory holiday that creates the extra day(s) and noted the province(s) where the holiday applies (some holidays are nationwide, others are provincial).  

| Long‑Weekend | Holiday | Date(s) (2023) | Province(s) / Notes |
|--------------|---------|----------------|---------------------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 1 – Jan 3 (Sun – Mon – Tue) | Nationwide (Jan 1 was Sunday → observed Mon 2) |
| **Family Day** | Family Day | Feb 20 (Fri) | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | Mar 31 (Fri) | Nationwide (all provinces observe) |
| **St. Patrick’s** | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 15 – Mar 17 (Sat – Sun – Fri) | Newfoundland & Labrador (March 17 was Fri) |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | May 20 – May 22 (Sat – Sun – Mon) | Nationwide (May 22 was Mon) |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day (observed) | Jul 1 – Jul 3 (Sat – Mon – Tue) | Nationwide (July 1 was Sat → observed Mon 3) |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | Sep 2 – Sep 4 (Sat – Sun – Mon) | Nationwide (Sep 4 was Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | Oct 7 – Oct 9 (Sat – Sun – Mon) | Nationwide (Oct 9 was Mon) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Nov 10 – Nov 13 (Fri – Sat – Mon – Tue) | Some provinces (e.g., Ontario, PEI, NB, NL, QC, AB, BC, SK, MB, YT, NT, NU) observe on Mon 13 |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | Dec 23 – Dec 25 (Sat – Sun – Mon) | Nationwide (Dec 25 was Mon) |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Data source** – Store the above table in a JSON or CSV file that your app can read at runtime.  
2. **Filtering** – Allow users to filter by province so they see only the long weekends that apply to their location.  
3. **Calendar integration** – When a user selects a long weekend, highlight the entire span (e.g., Jan 1 – Jan 3) so they can plan travel or time off.  
4. **Dynamic updates** – For future years, you can generate the same table programmatically using a holiday‑API or a library that calculates statutory holidays (e.g., `holidays` in Python or `date-fns` in JavaScript).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data formatted in a specific way (JSON, CSV, iCal, etc.) or if you need the list broken down by each province’s unique holidays!
